comments.author: Steward
comments.body: back when development was capped at 65k and many ships were capped on improvements, cruise light clippers and modified light clippers were right up there on speed. Not _the_ fastest mind you, but they did very well for themselves. if you teak panel one of these and max out sails and do the best you can on wave resistance they should hit 12-13 knots out in open sea in the right winds.

comments.author: Wrath
comments.body:
@Kirito-Kun Hello again ^^ To answer this question, all modified, custom, Commander's, etc etc ships are all Astro (NC) Ships. They are mostly based on player-built ships, but given special perks such as higher sails, larger hull, more dura, armour, etc than the normal player built one, as well as usually more improvements that may be done along with the lower lvl requirements. They have the same skills as the normal player-built ones too. May be gotten by luck through sailor bottles, or purchased from players selling them. :)

-GeneralOnox
